ios.desc:
Agent Notifier is a push notification platform purpose-built for AI agents, autonomous workflows, and developer tooling.

Let any script, agent, or backend push richly-typed notifications to your iPhone, with project grouping, live session progress, inline media, and lock-screen actions that round-trip back to the agent.

Features:
• Typed notifications: alerts, progress updates, session tracking, file attachments, URLs
• Project-based grouping with custom icons, colors, and delivery rules
• Live session status summaries and real-time updates
• Lock-screen action buttons that POST responses back to your agent
• Simple REST API - integrate in minutes with any language
• Priority levels from silent to emergency using the app’s iOS notification settings
• Sign in with Apple - no separate account or password to manage

Start free with every core feature unlocked: API keys, project feeds, media attachments, notification detail, and setup docs.

Agent Notifier Pro Monthly is $9.99 per month. Agent Notifier Pro Annual is $99.99 per year. Both auto-renewable plans provide unlimited notification sending while subscribed.

Privacy Policy: https://notifier.aicrew.in/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Pushover for the agentic era. Your agents finally have a phone.
